about_the_game:
You enter this magical world as a mischievous witch. You are a human who is happy to serve the vampire queen in her castle, but your kind is not tolerated by her vampire subjects. But you have a suitor who sees you not as a source of food, but as someone to be desired. But before you can reach her voluptuous arms, there are tasks you must fulfill. Will you be able to control your lonely, impatient desires as you fly from place to place?

Speaking of locations, the levels take place in two separate locations. One inside the castle where your movement is more restricted and one outside the castle where you can fly relatively freely.

Aside from flying, you have dash and two magic abilities. You are forbidden to damage the queen's belongings, so you have to dodge them, and your magic is useless against fire and blood, so you have to avoid them. However, you can use your spells to ward off creatures like bats and thorns! You will only lose one life when you hit them, but you have to start a little bit behind (at the checkpoint) as you fall off your broom when you hit large objects... Don't forget to capture hit points to help you overcome this difficult journey, you'll need them on this long journey.
